title: Most Serie A titles as a player since 2000
brief: Name the ten players who won the most Serie A titles from 2000/01 to 2025/26, counting only titles where they played at least one league game for the champions.

notes.Zlatan Ibrahimovic: Zlatan Ibrahimovic won 5 titles in this period, one short of the pool on 6.
notes.Arturo Vidal: Arturo Vidal won 5 titles in this period, one short of the pool on 6.
notes.Simone Padoin: Simone Padoin won 5 titles in this period, one short of the pool on 6.

notes.Marco Materazzi: Marco Materazzi won 5 titles in this period, one short of the pool on 6.
notes.Dejan Stankovic: Dejan Stankovic won 5 titles in this period, one short of the pool on 6.
notes.Esteban Cambiasso: Esteban Cambiasso won 5 titles in this period, one short of the pool on 6.
notes.Francesco Toldo: Francesco Toldo played in 4 of Inter's title seasons in this period (5 if you count 2009/10, when he was in the squad but didn't play).
notes.Gianluigi Buffon: Buffon's 10 leave out 2004/05 and 2005/06, the Juventus titles taken away after Calciopoli.

checks: Champions from Wikipedia's list of Italian champions and Transfermarkt's list of winners. Official titles only: 2004/05 (stripped from Juventus, never reassigned) and the original 2005/06 Juventus title don't count, and 2005/06 counts for Inter, who were awarded it. For each of the 25 title-winning seasons, every player with at least one league appearance for the champions was taken from Transfermarkt's club season stats page (leistungsdaten, IT1), then counted per player. Every player on 5 or more was then checked against the Serie A titles in the honours list of his Wikipedia article; all agree (Buffon, Bonucci and Chiellini's articles also note the two Calciopoli titles are left out). Bonucci's 9 include 2005/06 with Inter, where he played one league game. Places 7 to 10 are a pool of five players on 6.
